UI_ALC_Options_Info: A-Life: Caravans. These are your own options. Everything that applies to the whole game (how many caravans, their speed, trade, riders) is on the host's Sandbox page "A-Life: Caravans".
UI_ALC_Opt_Menu_tt: Show the [A-LIFE] Caravan entry in the right-click menu when a caravan car is within 18 tiles.
UI_ALC_Opt_Notices_tt: Show a short line over your head when you buy something from a caravan or pay a toll.
UI_ALC_Opt_WorldMap_tt: Draw every caravan (travelling in the ledger or on the road) on the world map (M): a square in the colour of its kind, a heading tick and the callsign.
UI_ALC_Opt_Labels_tt: Show the callsign and kind next to the world map markers.
